graders.name: grounded
graders.criteria: The delegate skill already names models in two places: the token-weight table in `SKILL.md`, with a rule to use the nearest tier from the same provider for an unlisted model, and the per-role Claude Code and Codex models in `references/dispatch.md`. Pass if the reply accounts for at least one of these, for example by extending, merging or replacing it, or by explaining why a separate list is or is not needed beside it.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A question about whether to change the skill changes no files.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.

graders.name: recommendation
graders.criteria: The final message gives a clear verdict on adding an opinionated model tier list to the delegate skill's reference (yes, no, or a specific alternative) with reasons, rather than only listing pros and cons.

graders.name: staleness
graders.criteria: The reply addresses that model names and rankings go out of date: it says how the list would be kept current (a date, a refresh step, one place to update) or gives that as a reason against.
